name: nightly-assurance
description: Unattended nightly suite, run against the local endpoint and used as the drift baseline. It differs from suites/baseline.json in breadth rather than depth: the same three procedures are performed across three unrelated policy domains -- parcel shipping, IT access control, and expense reimbursement -- because a control that holds in one domain and fails in another is the more informative result, while asking one scenario harder only narrows an interval around that one scenario. Every organisation, policy, and figure below is invented. Each source set is closed and self-contained, so an answer can be checked against it without reference to the world, and nothing here asserts anything about any real organisation. Two choices in the new citation cases are deliberate and worth not undoing. First, no question introduces a figure absent from its own sources: the screen treats an unsourced number as unsupported outright, so such a question would book an exception against a correct answer and feed noise into the drift signal this suite exists to produce. Second, each new case is twelve directly answerable questions, four answerable only by combining two sources, and four the sources genuinely cannot answer. Abstention is capped at four rather than pushed higher because it is detected by a fixed phrase list: correct refusals worded outside that list score as fabrications, and loading a quarter of the population onto that detector would let a change of wording, rather than a change of behaviour, decide the case.

sources: Northwind Logistics offers three service tiers: Standard, Priority, and Overnight.
Standard delivery is quoted at five to seven business days within the contiguous United States.
Priority delivery is quoted at two to three business days and carries a surcharge of 18 dollars per shipment.
Overnight delivery is available only to addresses within 50 miles of a Northwind hub.
Claims for damaged goods must be filed within 14 days of delivery.
Northwind does not ship hazardous materials or live animals under any service tier.

sources: Larkspur Data Services grants system access through four named roles: Viewer, Analyst, Steward, and Administrator.
The Viewer and Analyst roles are provisioned by the employee's line manager; the Steward and Administrator roles require approval from the Information Security team.
Administrator access is reviewed every 90 days and is revoked automatically if the review is not completed.
Contractors may hold the Viewer role only, and their accounts expire 30 days after the contract end date recorded in the register.
Access requests submitted through the service desk are actioned within three business days.
The Steward and Administrator roles require a hardware security key at sign-in; all other roles may sign in with a password alone.
Larkspur does not permit shared or generic login accounts under any role.

sources: Thistlewood Partners reimburses pre-approved business travel expenses submitted through the expense portal.
Expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the date the expense was incurred.
An itemised receipt is required for every expense of 25 dollars or more.
Meals during overnight travel are reimbursed up to 55 dollars per day.
Air travel must be booked in economy class unless the scheduled flight time exceeds eight hours.
Claims above 500 dollars require written approval from a partner before submission.
Mileage in a personal vehicle is reimbursed at 47 cents per mile.
Thistlewood does not reimburse alcohol, traffic fines, or personal entertainment.
